frame: metres, Z up, right handed; X and Y are the Matterport model's own, as the Model API and the MatterPak mesh give them, and Z is height above the floor (+0.006 m in the model)
source: read from Matterport model 169F7nENMza (917 Main Street, Unit 506, Houston, TX, 77002, US) by world/matterport.py: rooms, doorways and ceilings from the Model API's floor plan; furniture (695 boxes) and table tops (2) measured on the MatterPak mesh by world/mesh.py: anything standing between 0.1 and 2 m above the floor, away from the walls, boxed on a 0.1 m grid.
